## Summary

P26.1 — **scheduled live operations** (ticket
`docs/tickets/P26.1__scheduled-live-operations.md`, OPS.2), stacked on
`devin/p25-10-contradiction-serve-path`.

Every probe and every reingestion was a hand-run command — uptime data existed
as a single sweep and live sources only refreshed when someone remembered. Both
are now automatic, scheduled, and durably recorded, without bypassing the
ingestion gate, fabricating outcomes, or mutating the claim spine.

## What changed

- **`ops/cadence.toml`** — the scheduled-ops table as data (not code): probe
  targets + one `[[sources]]` row per green live-target source
  (`live_targets.toml` ∩ `is_loadable`) with cadence/cron/job/scheduler;
  `sig-ops cadence --check` fails on drift.
- **`ops/src/ops/gcs.py`** — stdlib `urllib` GCS JSON-API client (no SDK):
  put/list/get only, token via metadata-server → `gcloud` ADC → env override.
  No delete/overwrite — WORM-shaped per-run objects.
- **`ops/src/ops/scheduled.py`** — hosted probe sweep, per-target history fold
  (count / latest state / last-N p95), the `scheduled-ingest` wrapper that runs
  the SAME `connectors.runner.run_source` as a manual run, and WORM run-row
  persistence (local mirror + GCS object).
- **`sig-ops` new verbs** — `probe-hosted` (sweep → `ops/probes/<date>/<ts>.jsonl`
  + recorded alerts on DOWN via the existing `sig-alerts` receiver),
  `probe-history`, `scheduled-ingest` (run row → `ops/runs/<source>/<date>/<ts>.json`),
  `cadence`.
- **`ops/gcp/scheduled-ops.sh`** — `--check` plan-only / `--apply` gated on
  operator ADC: `sig-probe` + `sig-sched-probe` (6-hourly), 21
  `sig-ingest-<id>` jobs + `sig-sched-<id>` triggers, OIDC-invoked by the
  existing least-privilege `sig-scheduler` SA. `muckrock`'s P25.7 trigger is
  verified-not-duplicated; its job is upserted onto the run-row wrapper with
  the `sig-muckrock-refresh` binding preserved.
- **`ops/Dockerfile`** — installs `./ops` so the same image backs the jobs.
- **Test pin updates** — the base tip's GL-GATE-06 flip (13 flip-ready sources)
  predates this branch; six stale pins updated to the real registry state
  (38 permitted / 0 flip-ready; refuse-path tests now pin `journalrecord`).
  Gate behavior assertions unchanged.
